lean.name: Deduction.ch_core
lean.plain: A near-square-root bound for the kept characters’ weighted sum
lean.note: `ch_core` passes the summed count hypothesis and its lower bound for the character average to `CharacterBalanceMoves.core`. The resulting estimate, still multiplied by the size of the average, goes into the final size bound. The main reduction calls the helper that applies the count identity.

lean.name: Deduction.CharacterBalanceMoves.core
lean.plain: Bound the character sum over the subgroup annihilator
lean.note: The helper proves the inequality for an arbitrary translate before averaging over all translates. For each size and lift it combines the real part of `ch_balance` with `th_le`, which contributes the $2b/x$ allowance. The helper applies ch_balance for each size and lift, then takes real parts.
